The Balmer Series

The Balmer series is a specific set of spectral lines of hydrogen that are visible to the naked eye. It results from the electron making transitions between energy levels, specifically from levels with (i.e., from higher energy states) down to . These transitions release energy in the form of electromagnetic radiation, which we observe as the Balmer series.
